rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 116 of the Constitution and Article 35 of the Federal Constitutional Law on the Government, Government order No. 647-r of 7 May 2000 states that the Government of the Russian Federation surrenders its powers ('слагает свои полномочия') before the newly elected President.
rows.locator: Heading ('от 7 мая 2000 г. № 647-р, Москва') and sole operative sentence

rows.text: The order is signed 'И. о. Председателя Правительства Российской Федерации М.Касьянов' (acting Chairman of the Government).
